chunks: So, when you recite the Qur'an seek refuge in God from Satan the execrable.
ai.seo_question: What should one do before reciting the Qur'an?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this verse (Ayat al-Isti'adha) is often recited before the Fatiha during prayer, reflecting the belief that Satan seeks to distract the believer from the divine message. The phrase 'Satan the accursed' (ash-Shaytan ar-Rajim) emphasizes the active hostility of the devil towards those who engage with the Qur'an, necessitating spiritual vigilance. This practice underscores the importance of preparing the heart and mind to receive revelation with purity and focus.
